summary: Choose a primitive basis t of the frame M′ᴴk_f with an integral left inverse L; take l = Lᴴ·u for the frame coordinates u = tᴴk_fᴴy of y. Then u is integral by the character criterion, because zeroTermFin(ϱ_f(y)f) ≠ 0 is invariant under translation along k, and k_fᴴ(y − M′l) = 0 by the left inverse.

steps.claim: The matrix M′ᴴk_f has the left inverse k_coord·M (by M·M′ᴴ = 1 and k_coord·k = 1), so by IsValuationPair.exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul for (𝔸_f, Ô) there is an invertible t with M′ᴴk_f·t integral (hK) and with an integral left inverse L (hL, eL: L·M′ᴴk_f·t = 1). The witness is l = Lᴴ·u with u = tᴴk_fᴴy; two facts remain.
steps.lean:
(isValuationPair_Ohat.exists_isPrimitiveMatrix_mul (X := M'ᴴ *
  D.kAdelic.map snd) ⟨D.kCoord.map snd * M, by simp [← M.mul_assoc, m]⟩).elim fun t ⟨_, hK, L, hL,
  eL⟩ ↦ ⟨_, hL.isInt_conjTranspose.mulVec (mem_stdLattice_iff_psi₀.2 fun x hx ↦ smul_left_injective
  ℂ h (by simpa [by simpa using zeroTermFin_finHeisOp_finFrameVector D (t *ᵥ x) (w := 0) rfl,
  star_mulVec_dotProduct, m, finHeisOp.eq_1 V₀, ← M.mul_assoc] using congrArg (zeroTermFin D) (hf _
  (hK.mulVec hx) ▸ V.finHeisOp_comm y .. :).symm)), mulVec_injective_of_isUnit t.isUnit.star (by
    simpa [mulVec_sub, ← mulVec_mulVec] using! congr($eLᴴ *ᵥ _).symm)⟩

steps.claim: l ∈ Ô^n: Lᴴ is integral, so it suffices that u ∈ Ô^p, i.e. ψ₀(⟨x, u⟩) = 1 for all x ∈ Ô^p (mem_stdLattice_iff_psi₀). For x ∈ Ô^p, M′ᴴk_f t x ∈ Ô^n (hK), so by hf and M·M′ᴴ = 1, ϱ_f(k_f t x) fixes f. Commuting ϱ_f(y) past ϱ_f(k_f t x) produces the factor ψ₀(⟨x, u⟩), and translation along k is invisible in zeroTermFin (zeroTermFin_finHeisOp_finFrameVector with w = 0). Hence zeroTermFin(ϱ_f(y)f) = ψ₀(⟨x, u⟩)·zeroTermFin(ϱ_f(y)f), and since this vector is non-zero (h), ψ₀(⟨x, u⟩) = 1.
steps.lean:
hL.isInt_conjTranspose.mulVec (mem_stdLattice_iff_psi₀.2 fun x hx ↦ smul_left_injective
  ℂ h (by simpa [by simpa using zeroTermFin_finHeisOp_finFrameVector D (t *ᵥ x) (w := 0) rfl,
  star_mulVec_dotProduct, m, finHeisOp.eq_1 V₀, ← M.mul_assoc] using congrArg (zeroTermFin D) (hf _
  (hK.mulVec hx) ▸ V.finHeisOp_comm y .. :).symm)),

steps.claim: k_fᴴ(y − M′l) = 0: multiplying by the invertible tᴴ, tᴴk_fᴴ(y − M′Lᴴu) = u − (L M′ᴴk_f t)ᴴu = u − u = 0 by eL.

    simpa [mulVec_sub, ← mulVec_mulVec] using! congr($eLᴴ *ᵥ _).symm)⟩
